title: The Fatal Curse of Unreturned Love — Part 5

series.summary: Rentaro rushes back to the shrine to ask the God of Love how to choose between his two soulmates, only to learn the horrific truth: if a destined soulmate is rejected, she will die.

segments.voiceover_text: Receiving two confessions from dream girls should be paradise, but for Rentaro, it feels like sheer torture.
Unable to bear crushing either girl's spirit, he sprints through the dark back to the sacred shrine.
He summons the God of Love, desperate for advice on how to choose between his two soulmates.
The deity's cheerful grin fades into grim gravity as he delivers a chilling warning.
The god reveals the horrifying truth: if any destined soulmate fails to find love with Rentaro, fatal misfortune will strike and she will die—leaving Rentaro only hours to save both girls.
